_: The fit score's fixed case set (src/ai/score.py SYSTEM, score_bands.py, score_search.py), replayed by tools/score-cases.py on the person's Claude plan ($0). Fictional people and postings only. Expect: score_max / score_min bound the final score (after the search part), fit_max bounds the AI's own fit to the search, gap says the cv_gap line must be filled. Added 7 Nov 2026 (owner: a Cessna Citation captain job, licence required, scored 85 while the card said Not eligible). location_min bounds the location part; a case's places stand in for Strategy → Locations and profile_add is appended to the golden profile (12 Nov 2026). Changed 13 Nov 2026 (owner: "We should be realistic"): the ring is the scorer's own overall, so a career change case bounds score (final = overall) and fit_min/fit_max bound the AI's fit to the search; every case also holds ring_over_fit_max 25 (overall at most the role fit + 25, in failures()); career_change says the AI flagged the search as another field.

cases.why: Owner's case, 7 Nov 2026: a captain / first officer job that needs a type rating, a commercial licence and flight hours, for a person with none of them, scored 85 'Strong match' while the card said Not eligible: No aviation experience or licences.

job.title: Captain / First Officer, Cessna Citation C525
job.description: We fly a Cessna Citation C525 (CJ1) on private charter flights across Europe. Captain: valid EASA ATPL or CPL/IR, C525 type rating, at least 1,500 flight hours, 500 on jets, class 1 medical. First Officer: valid EASA CPL/IR with multi-engine rating, C525 type rating, at least 500 flight hours. Base Zurich, roster of 12 days on and 8 off, salary by experience. Send your licence copies, logbook summary and medical certificate with your CV.

cases.why: The over-correction trap: a cadet scheme that trains a person from zero is within reach of a person with no licence, so it keeps its high search fit. The fit to the search stays high; the ring is the scorer's own overall (13 Nov 2026 replay: Claude 38-52, Codex 62-80 for a software CV; the rule ring <= fit + 25 holds on both).
